{{Quote|The whole of the Galactic Republic is backing us, and everything still hinges on cutting deals with criminals.''"<br />"''Wars are never won on the front lines.|The [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Gault Rennow]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
A '''mission''' took place on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Mek-Sha]] around [[3627 BBY]] as part of a larger conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Republic prevented the Empire to destroy a key Republic fleet intended to reinforce [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where the Empire was planning to assault the [[Meridian Complex]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I checked with General Daeruun, and we have a fleet headed to Mek-Sha for refueling. The pieces fit. Arn and I will head there right away to meet with the fleet's commander. See if we can't start rooting out the Imps. If we can stop them on Mek-Sha like we did here, we might just stand a chance of defending Corellia.|[[Tau Idair]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] assembled one of the largest attack fleets in galactic history in order to strike the [[Meridian Complex]], the most advanced Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]] was tasked to take command of several Republic fleets in order to bring reinforcements to defend the Meridian Complex. However, Daeruun could not bring its fleets to Corellia without refueling, and predicted that the Republic forces would be attacked where they were refueling, before they could reach Corellia. The General therefore requested the help of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in order to defend these reinforcements and secure refueling operations.<ref name="TOR:TToW">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|The Tide of War|Carrick Station}}</ref>

[[File:29th Fleet.png|thumb|left|280px|The 29th Republic Fleet in orbit of Mek-Sha]]
On [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the Eternal Alliance and their allies [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|successfully prevented]] the Empire to destroy the [[Eleventh Fleet (Galactic Republic)|11th Republic Fleet]]. In addition, they captured a member of the [[Dark Council]], [[Darth Savik]], who revealed that the [[Twenty-Ninth Fleet|29th Republic Fleet]] was the next target. This fleet was intended to refuel at [[Mek-Sha]] before sailing to Corellia.<ref name="TOR:StT">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Springing the Trap|Onderon}}</ref>

==The mission==
===The gangs of Mek-Sha===
{{Quote|Like I said, Mek-Sha's neutral, so your ships don't get topped off until the powers that be vote on it. See, Mek-Sha used to be run by the Hutts. The locals kicked them out while they were distracted with Makeb, then started running things themselves. So all the big decisions come down to a vote by the leaders of the five biggest crews. Lucky for you, I'm one of them. Huttbreaker, she led the revolt, so now she runs the docks. She'll vote for you--fuel sales go straight to her pocket. So you just need one more vote.|[[Junker Jott]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
[[File:Dol_Narlock_and_Junker_Jott.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vide-Admiral Narlock and Junker Jott brief the Alliance Commander.]]
Upon arriving on the [[Asteroid base|asteroid station]] Mek-Sha, the Alliance Commander headed to [[Junker's Junction]] to meet with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tau Idair]] and [[Arn Peralun]]. Tau introduced the Commander to [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice-Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]], commander of the Republic's 29th Fleet, and to [[Junker Jott]], the station's chief engineer and former Republic veteran. Jott explained that Mek-Sha was officially neutral and controlled by five powerful gangs. Any important decision, including decision of permitting the Republic to refuel, required a majority vote from the leaders of the five crews. Jott himself represented [[Junker Jott's crew|one]] of these groups and, being a Republic sympathizer, he would indeed vote for. In addition, there was [[Huttbreaker]], who controlled the docks. She would vote in favor of the plan, as fuel sales would bring her money. However, one of the five gangs was [[the Brothers]], a group of fanatical [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] known to do business with the Sith Empire. As the Empire was their most important client, they would certainly not vote for anything advantageous for the Republic. The only two parties left for the tiebreaking vote were the [[Dar'manda]] mercenaries and the [[Harido Wald]] smugglers. The Commander had to convince at least one of these two groups to win the vote.<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />

Meanwhile, [[Darth Shaar]], a member of the Dark Council, arrived on Mek-Sha to negotiate with the gangs in order to prevent the Republic to win the vote.<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" /> Moreover, the Empire discovered a manner to completely destroy the Republic fleet.<ref name="TOR:DtD" /> Huttbreaker tightly controlled the fuel sold by the station. She had build in a failsafe that, in case of emergency, would neutralize all fuel on the station and any ships attached with a pulse.<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" /> The Empire saw the potential of amplifying the failsafe to destroy the Republic ships during refueling.<ref name="TOR:DtD" />

[[File:Huttbreaker auction.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Huttbreaker's auction]]
The Alliance Commander and Darth Shaar traveled to the [[Huttbreaker's compound]] where Huttbreaker was holding an auction, which all crew leaders would attend. Both intended to use this opportunity to negotiate with the gang leaders. The Commander encountered there two members of their Alliance, [[Gault Rennow]] and [[Hylo Visz]], who offered their assistance. Rennow explained that the two had made several agreements with the people of Mek-Sha over the years and thus possessed knowledge of how to manipulate them. The group then listened to Huttbreaker's welcoming speech, in which she explained how Mek-Sha was gaining influence and prosperity through the war between the Republic and the Empire. Huttbreaker then bought the Commander a drink and emphasized the importance of remaining peaceful on the station, just as Darth Shaar joined them. Huttbreaker officially introduced Darth Shaar. The Alliance Commander asked what brought her to Mek-Sha, to which she replied that she came to deal with minor, punishable violations of import and export regulations. The Commander later went to discuss with the two gang leaders who could potentially make them win the vote: [[Indigo (Mandalorian)|Indigo]] of the Dar'manda and [[Veek (Rodian)|Veek]] of Harido Wald. The Commander thus spoke with Indigo, leader of the Dar'manda, a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] working as mercenaries and arms dealers. Indigo quickly dismissed with the explanation that the Dar'manda on Mek-Sha had no interest to support the Republic. Nevertheless, Indigo offered to speak with them later, in the [[Slugfall Cantina]]. The Commander also spoke with Veek the Sneak, leader of the Harido Wald smuggling ring. Veek immediately expressed his desire for a lucrative relationship and invited the Commander to visit him later in the [[Harido Wald territory]].<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />

===Underworld diplomacy===
{{Quote|Veek's a businessman. He can be anybody's friend if there's an upshot for him. Just have to figure out what he needs and make sure he gets it. The other crew leader is Indigo. Mandalorian--well, ex-Mandalorian. Same with his crew. They're called something like Dar... Darma....''"<br />"''Dar'manda. They're mercs and gunrunners. Indigo has some kind of rivalry with Veek, so it's a good thing you only need one of them to vote your way.|[[Gault Rennow]] and [[Hylo Visz]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
The Commander traveled to the [[Slugfall Harbor]] to discuss with Indigo in the cantina. The Mandalorians and the Harido Wald were rivals on Mek-Sha. Indigo expressed his wish to be rid of Veek the Sneak and unexpectedly requested the Commander to assassinate the smuggler leader. After refusing this outrageous task, the Commander decided to speak with Veek and visited him in his cantina. Veek stated that the Alliance needed to do something for him to secure the necessary majority of votes. He explained that he had been secretly negotiating with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] with the aim of having his crew allowed to operate in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], what would be considered as a treason by the other gangs of Mek-Sha. Unfortunately for him, an envoy of the Cartel had been captured by the Exchange shortly after their arrival but he could not rescue the envoy without being exposed. Veek needed an outworlder to deal with that matter discreetly.<ref name="TOR:UD">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Underworld Diplomacy|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

[[File:Eesmu_and_Commmander.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Eesmu and the Exchange welcome the Commmander.]]
The Alliance Commander and [[Jakarro]] headed to [[Brzo's Wells]] and searched for the Exchange's base by scanning several communications kiosks in the area. After several skirmishes with Exchange henchmen, the location of the Exchange warehouse was discovered. In the base, the Commander encountered the Hutt envoy [[Eesmu]] and an Exchange boss. The Commander observed that the envoy and the Exchange appeared to be allied, a fact soon confirmed. Eesmu explained that Veek had let her brother die during a smuggling operation. Eesmu therefore wanted revenge while the Exchange wanted more land and the Hutts wanted to eliminate Veek, so cooperation seemed advantageous. They then planned to divide the remains of Harido Wald among themselves. The criminals attacked the Commander but the later managed to kill them. The Commander later returned to Veek and explained him the situation. The smuggler was saddened by the turn of events and claimed that he only wanted to heal the anger between Mek-Sha and the Hutts to ensure greater security for his people. He then asked if the Commander would be willing to work as his bodyguard, which the latter politely declined. Veek eventually thanked the Alliance Commander for his help and, as promised, accepted to vote for refueling the Republic ships.<ref name="TOR:HE" />

===Liberation of the slaves===
{{Quote|I need your help. There are slaves, dozens of them. The Brothers are loading them into shuttles--Imperial shuttles! We have to stop them!|[[Arn Peralun]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:BK" />}}
[[File:ArnMekSha.png|thumb|left|220px|Arn Pelarun processes his actions.]]
Although the mission seemed successful, Arn Peralun contacted the Alliance Commander thereafter and requested assistance. He explained that the Brothers were loading dozens of slaves onto Imperial shuttles and wanted to rescue them. The Commander was reluctant to violate Huttbreaker's instructions but was forced to intervene when Arn's signal cut out. The Commander immediately contacted Tau Idair. The Commander entered the [[Brothers Slave Processing|Brothers' slave processing center]] through the [[Scrap Pit]]. Several brothers blocked his path there, whom he was forced to kill. When the path to Arn was clear, the stranger discovered that the Jedi was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choking]] one of the Brothers. Arn dropped his victim alive and declared that he had not wanted to kill any of them, but had no choice. The Jedi then began to blame himself for letting his hate for slavers make him close to succumb to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Tau Idair suddenly arrived and inquired about her Padawan. Peralun immediately apologized to his master, who suggested to leave before the Brothers or the Empire sent reinforcements.<ref name="TOR:BK" />

Arriving back at [[Junker's Junction]], the Commander and Idair reported the situation to Vice-Admiral Narlock and Junker Jott. Jott was outraged by what happened in the Brothers' territory, while Tau tried to protect her Padawan. Jott was afraid the Republic had to face consequences but Narlock declared that Huttbreaker would still sell the fuel, for an additional 40% payment.<ref name="TOR:BK" />

===Attack on the docks===
{{Quote|There are three main approaches the Imps could use for their assault: the main catwalks, the maintenance tunnels, or the docks themselves, via shuttle.|[[Tau Idair]]|<ref name="TOR:DtD" />}}
[[File:Republic_on_Mek-Sha.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Republic troops prepare to defend the docks.]]
Finally, the vote took place and the majority of the gangs of Mek-Sha accepted to let the Republic reinforcements refuel. Vice-Admiral Narlock later informed his allies that the fleet was en route for refueling, although he was worried about an Imperial assault. The fleet was vulnerable during the refueling and the vice-admiral suspected that the Empire would attempt to take control of the failsafe in the fueling system to use it against the Republic ships.<ref name="TOR:DtD" />

[[File:Anri captured 2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vide-Admiral Narlock confronts Major Anri.]]
The Republic and its allies immediately gathered their forces to the [[Fueling Docks|docks]] of Mek-Sha. They expected the Empire to attack from three access points: the main catwalks, the maintenance tunnels, or the docks themselves via shuttle. The Alliance Commander, the most skilled combatant, was assigned to the main catwalk: the most direct route for the enemy. Tau Idair decided Arn and she would defend the tunnels, expecting [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] to be advantageous in close quarters. Junker Jott immediately dispatched his droids to back them. In addition, Narlock gathered his best troops to defend the docks from incoming [[Imperial assault shuttle]]s, despite limited anti-aircraft weapons. At that moment, Veek the Sneak appeared, offering assistance. Under the pretext of test flights, he brought his men to the docks, who would then return fire on any strange shuttles firing. The Alliance Commander thanked Veek and the group then split up and took up their positions.<ref name="TOR:DtD" />

[[File:Anri_surrenders.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Major Anri surrenders to the Commander.]]
While Narlock reported that Imperial shuttles were arriving, the Commander and Jakarro encountered Imperials troops in the docks. The pair fought [[Imperial soldier]]s and three [[Sith Executioner]]s. Meanwhile, Tau and Arn also reported encountering enemies. Then a second wave of shuttles arrived. After the last Executioner was defeated, Jott reported that the Imperials had managed to get into the command center and intended to neutralize all the fuel from there. The Alliance Commander wanted to intervene quickly but was stopped by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tarnux]], another Sith Executioner, who stood before the elevator. After a fierce duel, Tarnux whispered his defeat to his master, Darth Shaar, as he lay dying.<ref name="TOR:DtD" />

[[File:Empire_escapes_Mek-Sha.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tau Idair watches Imperial shuttle fleeing Mek-Sha.]]
The Commander and Jakarro then took the elevator to the command center of the Mek-Sha docks. Through a few corridors. they reached a main room where Narlock and a [[Republic trooper]] were facing Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]]. When the Alliance Commander arrived and Anri identified them as the being who defeated the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], she immediately surrendered and laid down her weapon. Narlock switched his blaser to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] and neutralized the major. After the building was secured by the Republic, the last Imperial troops retreated and Imperial shuttles departed, thereby allowing the Republic fleet to complete its refueling.<ref name="TOR:DtD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Thank you all. You saved my ships--and you may have saved the whole of the Republic.|[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice-Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock|Narlock]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:DtD" />}}
The mission to Mek-Sha was a success for the Republic. The 29th Fleet was able to refuel and hyperspace to the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] in time. The Alliance Commander and the Jedi Tau Idair and Arn Peralun also departed to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Eventually, the Republic fleets rescued at Onderon and Mek-Sha would arrive safely at Corellia to participate in the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]]. The Republic would successfully defend its shipyards and emerge victorious, causing a decisive defeat for the Sith Empire.<ref name="TOR:OM" />
